title: 밴드 한 묶음
suno_analysis_sp: K-Pop ballad. A clean, fingerpicked acoustic guitar plays a repetitive arpeggiated pattern in 4/4 time. A soft, breathy female vocal performs a melodic line with heavy plate reverb. The arrangement is minimalist, focusing on the interplay between the vocal and the acoustic guitar. The tempo is 72 BPM in the key of G Major.
suno_analysis_lyrics:
[Intro]
[fingerpicked acoustic guitar arpeggio]

[Verse 1]
[breathy female vocals with heavy plate reverb]
눈을 감으면 문이 보여
매일 밤 같은 문을
손잡이를 돌리면 열려
그 안엔 네가 있었어
복도 끝 흐릿한 저 사이에서
네 목소리가 들려와
이름을 부르는 것 같은
